name: Resume lifecycle integrity
description: Current resume-required state is exposed by `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:652` when a task retains `pauseSnapshot` or a work deviation remains in `resume-required`/`resolved`; `task_start` in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4320` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1334` clears checkpoints and resolves deviations. Generic task updates still permit some status-to-in-progress paths, allowing lifecycle cleanup to be bypassed. The dashboard renders a redundant per-row resume badge in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx:42`. Establish one guarded start/resume flow for Pi, MCP, server, and Web UI while preserving non-lifecycle status updates and testable pending-resume behavior.
